answer: Grant identity through a quorum of issuers: each applicant must hold credentials from three of five types — bank, employer, school, utility, registry — each bound to one public key, each issuer capped at 100 per epoch. A mirror check rejects any credential used by two identities, and an issuer caught duplicating loses its licence and has its identities frozen. Honest agents pass once, but a farmer needing 1,000 fakes must corrupt three issuers per fake, so cost grows with every fake; a gale of applications from one issuer triggers an audit, and the vine extends through clean issuers.
